text:
Ava: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thread for release cadence, oncall swaps, quality bars, SLAs. Keep Qs short.
Diego: Are we changing patch freeze? 48h -> ?
Ava: Proposal: patch freeze 24h, major 72h. Need SRE thumbs.
Liam: SRE OK with 24h if canary + CI pass. Canary gate: error_rate <1% and p99 latency <5% regression.
Priya: For Dedicated customers, do we need notice before a patch that might affect latency? PM/Legal input.
Maya: Request: publish a 5-line ship checklist (critical tests, smoke, changelog, perf smoke, rollback plan).
Nora: Can we allow one-off oncall swaps with buddy and rotation lead sign-off?
Liam: Yes with PD update and calendar invite. No reduction in handoff overlap.
Diego: SLA query: what counts as failure? retries? client timeouts?
Ava: SLA measures server-side failures (5xx/gateway). Retries don't change SLA. We'll add examples.
SamBot: deploy-bot: "Canary default: 30% for 15m, auto-promote on green metrics."
Ava: Thanks — drop snippets here (changelog lines, PD swap text). I'll publish a summary next week. ✅
